evidence.note: Databricks data source kind offers Aad (AuthorizationUri), Key (PAT) and UsernamePassword (client credentials).
DatabricksMultiCloud offers OAuth (OidcStartLogin/OidcFinishLogin/OidcRefresh), Key and UsernamePassword.
Credential kinds UsernamePassword, Key and OAuth are mapped to driver connection properties.
Generates a PKCE code verifier, a S256 code challenge and sends code_challenge_method = S256.
Refresh handler exchanges refresh_token for a new token through OidcTokenRequest.
The PAT is passed as UID=token and PWD=<key> in the ODBC connection string (AuthMech 3), not as an HTTP header, query string or body.
ADBC path passes the key as adbc.spark.token in the connection string.
Odbc.DataSource is the ODBC transport.
Odbc.Query runs wrapped native queries over ODBC.
ADBC transport through Adbc.Connection with the Databricks ADBC driver (AdbcDriver, lines 2044-2080).
SqlCapabilitiesNativeQuery is built from DefaultConfig[SqlCapabilities] with overrides for LimitClauseKind, literals and Sql92Translation.
SQLGetInfo overrides (SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES, SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS, SQL_NUMERIC_FUNCTIONS, SQL_STRING_FUNCTIONS, SQL_SQL92_VALUE_EXPRESSIONS) are declared.
Options record passes SqlCapabilities, SQLColumns and SQLGetInfo handlers to Odbc.DataSource.
host (server host name) is url-or-server; httpPath names the SQL warehouse, a resource inside the host, so database-or-resource-id.
optional options record of connector settings.
The SQL query text is passed as its own parameter (sqlQuery), covered by other.

options-fields.text: The options record is validated by AdvancedOptions.pqm and accepts: Catalog, Database (default schema), QueryTags, EnableAutomaticProxyDiscovery, Implementation (2.0 = ADBC, or System Default), Protocol (rest or default), plus advanced settings such as BatchSize, EnableArrow, EnableQueryResultDownload, EnableQueryResultLZ4Compression, EnableMultipleCatalogsSupport, ScopeCurrentCatalog, MaxNumResultFileDownloadThreads, MaxConsecutiveResultFileDownloadRetries, RowsFetchedPerBlock, DefaultStringColumnLength, DecimalColumnScale, UseNativeQuery, EnablePKFK, MetricViewBiCompatibilityMode, EnableStoredProcedures, ShowSystemSchemas, CancelQueryExplicitly, SSP_use_cached_result, TokenRenewLimit, and others listed in the table.

evidence.note: Documented optional record fields: Catalog, Database, QueryTags, EnableAutomaticProxyDiscovery, Implementation, Protocol.
Full table of accepted option keys and their ODBC/ADBC mappings.
Complex STRUCT/ARRAY/MAP column values returned as JSON text are parsed with Json.Document (ToNullableJson).
ADBC results come from the Databricks ADBC driver (Arrow-based result path) through Adbc.Connection.
ODBC driver returns rows as tables through Odbc.DataSource.
Connector maps Databricks SQL type names to M types (DatabricksTypeMap and GetPowerQueryType).
Builds the M table type with Type.ForRecord from the connector's own type mapping.
Table.TransformColumns converts complex column cells to typed JSON values.
Table.TransformColumns converts duration tick values in returned data cells to Duration.
SQLColumns rewrites driver TYPE_NAME metadata, which stays driver-provided.
Result columns are renamed to the declared result type (#table(resultType, {})), so an empty result keeps the declared columns.
Web.Contents with ManualStatusHandling is only used for the auth endpoint; transport has no web-contents data path, so the question's applies_when excludes this connector.
Function type carries Documentation.Name, Documentation.FieldCaption, Documentation.FieldDescription and Documentation.SampleValues.
Documentation.AllowedValues for EnableAutomaticProxyDiscovery, Implementation and Protocol.
Documentation.Name and LongDescription on the query function.
Catalog list is discovered at runtime via GetCatalogs; rows are navigable folders (isLeaf false).
Schemas are discovered per catalog at runtime, another folder level.
HierarchicalNavigation = not HasSchema; catalog/schema tree when no default schema is set.
TestConnection calls BuildTestConnectionResult with Databricks.Contents, the shared entry function, with no probe flag.
Returns the entry function name with host and httpPath, so the gateway test evaluates a normal query.
Table.View OnSelectRows folds navigation selections (FoldNavigationStep).
Table.View OnNativeQuery and OnNativeStatement handlers.
SqlView.Generator with DatabricksSqlGenerator builds SQL behind Table.View for the ADBC path.
Connector-written SQL text generator with AstVisitor overrides.
ODBC SqlCapabilities and SQLGetInfo overrides shape ODBC folding.
OnSelectRows on the database navigation table.
OnSelectRows on the schema navigation table.
OnSelectRows on the table navigation table.

native-query-enabled.text: Native query is enabled by an OnNativeQuery handler on the schema navigation table (GetSchemas), which runs NativeQuery, and by the Publish record's NativeQueryProperties with DefaultOptions EnableFolding = true.

evidence.note: OnNativeQuery handler calls NativeQuery.
NativeQueryProperties with NavigationSteps and DefaultOptions EnableFolding = true.
Loads .pqm modules (AdvancedOptions.pqm, QueryHelpers.pqm, QueryTagsHelper.pqm, OdbcConstants.pqm, Diagnostics.pqm) via Extension.Contents and Expression.Evaluate.
Extension.LoadString reads strings from resources.
Extension.Contents loads PNG icons.
Diagnostics.Trace at Information level runs with no EnableTraceOutput-style switch.
Unconditional Diagnostics.Trace for implementation choice.
